summary: Humboldt County steel lookout built 1934; dismantled before 2011, with the cab and 14 feet of tower reported lying on the summit; a 2006 CAL FIRE plan to remove and display it was not carried out as written.

facts.design: 45-foot Aermotor steel tower with a Forest Service BC-201 residence
facts.status_note: Tower dismantled before 2011; the register says the cab and 14 feet of tower remain laid on their side at the original site

access.note: Mountain is privately held; an older register note (marked 10/91) says the site is not open to the public and lies about 2.2 miles from the nearest paved road

facts.agency: California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (CAL FIRE), Humboldt-Del Norte Unit

events.note: Facilities built 1934 per the register; a 1930 plan and a 1931 newspaper item gave earlier dates
Station near Harris closed for the season; F.R. Chase named as lookout man (clipping dated October 26, 1935)
Pete Monahan named as lookout operator in a 1982 photo caption
State officials said the fire lookouts were exposed to unsafe radio levels from the KERG antenna; FCC cut power to 2,000 watts until fire season ended
CAL FIRE notice of exemption (posted August 21, 2006) for removal to a conservation camp for restoration and possible display in Garberville; no record found that the display happened
Register says dismantled before 2011; 2011 is the June 25 visit that found it already dismantled. Actual removal date unknown
Registered November 9, 2019 as US 1802, CA 40; nominated by Brad Eells

corrections.why: The register gives removal as 'Prior to 2011'. The 2011 date is when a visit found the tower already dismantled, not when it was removed.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A 1931 newspaper item said a thirty-foot steel tower would be erected in spring 1931. The register says the facilities were not constructed until 1934 and describes a 45-foot tower. The story follows the register's 1934 date and height.

A 2006 CAL FIRE notice planned to remove the lookout intact for restoration and possible display. A June 2011 visit found it dismantled with the fate of the cab unknown. The register says the cab and 14 feet of tower remain on the original site. The story reports the register's account and says the accounts differ. No source read says the planned display happened.

sources.title: Pratt Mountain Lookout Removal and Restoration (SCH 2006088195)

notes_for_editor: Three sources. Register (1934 build, 45-ft tower) conflicts with a 1931 newspaper (planned 30-ft tower, spring 1931); the story uses the register. The 2006 CAL FIRE notice planned removal for restoration and possible display; no source read says the display happened, and the register says the cab and 14 ft remain on site, so the plan and the register do not match. Corrected the brief's removed year: 2011 is the visit that found the tower already dismantled. The 1931, 1935 and 1985 items come from the californialookouts clippings, which quote newspapers; the originals were not read. The 1985 KERG item is cited to the clipping only. No photo URLs captured (captions and credits only). Staffing 1982 is the photo caption; no later staffing found. Two WebSearch calls used: the second found no record of the planned display.
